review_question: Is this bounded prospective authorization safe, internally consistent, executable after approval, and correctly separated from the later execution result?
review_must_not_require: A final candidate SHA before the commit containing this Decision and its qualifying review exists.
An evidence ref before this prospective authorization permits its creation.
A merge-tree SHA before the candidate is frozen.
Validation results before validation is authorized and executed.
candidate_final_commit_binding_rule: The immutable candidate SHA is the Git commit produced by the single authorized finalization commit containing this Decision, its qualifying v0.2 review, the preserved non-qualifying v0.1 records, and the cockpit update. The concrete SHA cannot be embedded in its own content and MUST instead be captured by the remote ref and the later external attestation.
exact_authorized_action: After one qualifying exact qwen3.7-max prospective Decision review, commit this v0.2 Decision, its completed review, the preserved v0.1 non-qualifying records, and the cockpit update as exactly one final candidate commit. Push the candidate ref once and freeze it. Verify the remote candidate ref equals that commit and the canonical ref still equals ccf473f3ea29d5f58326e5b3bf0f57e3536ddd14. Create the distinct evidence ref codex/ce-g11b-atomic-integration-evidence from the immutable candidate commit. Compute the exact canonical plus candidate merge tree. In one disposable worktree run the complete validation contract. Record the concrete candidate SHA, canonical SHA, merge-tree SHA, commands, exits, counts, drift checks, and PASS or FAIL only in a separate Result and Report committed to the evidence ref. Push the evidence ref. Fail closed on any drift or failed check. Do not create or mutate PRs, close PR #22, merge, release, deploy, or modify servers.
stop_conditions: The v0.2 prospective Decision review is not HTTP 200, curl exit 0, exact qwen3.7-max APPROVE with zero blockers and zero required corrections.
Candidate finalization requires more than one commit or any later candidate commit.
Candidate or canonical remote ref drifts after binding.
Evidence ref already exists or is not distinct from candidate.
Merge-tree construction, JSON, Schema, dependency, site, static or CE validation fails.
Any PR mutation, closure, merge, release, deployment or server action is required.
